text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? All this strain is startin' to show on
my face.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm appearin' in races, maybe I
should
put more effort into my skin care.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't just wax my face up like I
would a
motorcycle...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta use some of that sea cucumber
lotion
like Mom does. I bet Scarlet has
some.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I definitely don't wanna end up owin' her

anything! Aughhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka continues to worry about the
condition of
her skin...
